agentModel.principle: Multi-agent is CONDITIONAL, not default. Agent count scales with project complexity.

tiers.trigger: Default for all projects unless complexity demands more

rules: Single Codex agent with harness-guided phased execution
Harness enforces stage gates between phases
State file persists across session boundaries
Diagnostic Gate after each major phase

tiers.trigger: >100 files, auth, DB, 3+ apps, financial/compliance risk
rules: Agent 4 (Verifier): Diagnostic Gate, integration check, negative controls
State file is single source of truth

forbiddenPatterns: Multi-agent as default for simple projects
Agent count exceeding project complexity need

allocationRules.writeScopeDisjoint: No two agents may write to the same file
allocationRules.integrationGate: Agent 4 (Verifier) validates cross-agent API contracts and file integrity
allocationRules.handoffProtocol: Each agent produces a completion receipt before handoff
